bugs.error_message: Prod web (Vercel) is a black screen after commit 418d4a7 (fix(deck): enforce filters and rebalance For You). Console: SyntaxError: Cannot use import.meta outside a module — the whole JS bundle fails to parse, React never mounts, only the dark static shell renders.
bugs.root_cause: filterStore.ts newly imported zustand/middleware (persist). On web, Metro resolves zustand via the import exports condition to esm/middleware.mjs, which contains import.meta.env checks in devtools code. Expo static export loads bundles as classic scripts where import.meta is a parse-time SyntaxError, killing the entire bundle. Native was fine (react-native condition -> CJS). Secondary latent crash: persisted user_preferences query cache from before the schema change lacks excluded_genres, and useDeck called prefs?.excluded_genres.map() unguarded.
bugs.fix: metro.config.js resolveRequest override routes zustand/* to its CJS build (require.resolve) on web only, matching what native already uses. useDeck now optional-chains prefs?.excluded_genres?.map(). Verified by building the web export locally and loading it headlessly: pageerror gone, app renders.

bugs.error_message: Taste signal counted 'down' (Seen) swipes as dislikes, poisoning the genre profile of users who honestly mark watched titles; all directions weighed equally; no time decay; onboarding genre selection unused in For You (pure popularity on cold start); strong repeated passes on a genre barely affected ranking during cold start.
bugs.root_cause: useTasteSignal used raw counts with isNegative = left||down and no weights/decay; composer personalizationScore required totalSwipes>0 so an onboarding prior could never apply; cold-start weighting (wPersonal 0.2) let popularity outrank a consistently disliked genre.
bugs.fix: Shared buildTasteSignal: per-direction weights up+4/right+3/down+0.5/left-1 with exp(-days/30) decay; withColdStartPrior seeds onboarding genres (+1.5); personalizationScore fires on any genre signal, amplifies firmly negative signals (base<-0.5 ×3) and clamps to [-2,2].

bugs.error_message: User batch report: undo button overlaps deck action buttons; trailers play in a small horizontal strip; some trailers buttons don't work; watchlist/title share button doesn't work; For You deck composes once then claims exhausted; diagonal swipes possible; triage swipe-up (Remove) doesn't work; filter change should lazy-load first cards immediately.
bugs.root_cause: (1) Undo pill absolutely positioned at top:-24 (height 40) overlapped the action bar buttons. (2) Trailers player was constrained to the top 40% band at 16:9. (3) The play-overlay container (absolute, bottom:25%, default pointerEvents) swallowed taps over the side Like button; Share.share url param is iOS-only so Android shares had no link. (4) Title-detail share downloaded the poster via FileSystem and passed a local file:// uri as Share url — Android ignores url and any download failure alerted 'Share failed'. (5) Deck refill effect required remaining > 0, so a deck that composed to 0 (common in For You after exclusions) never fetched the next page; MAX_PAGES_PER_SESSION=5 capped the pool at 100; recommendations RPCs gated initial render. (6) SwipeCard applied raw translations — diagonal drags possible. (7) SwipeCard clamped ty>=0 and never emitted 'up', but triage maps up→Remove — gesture dead.
bugs.fix: (1) Undo pill moved to top:-56 with a solid dark chip background. (2) Player now fills the page (width×height letterboxed vertical). (3) Play overlay + info overlay pointerEvents='box-none'; YouTube link embedded in the share message. (4) Title share is text + TMDB/trailer link (url kept for iOS); FileSystem removed. (5) Refill triggers when remaining <= threshold INCLUDING 0, gated on !isFetching && data, page cap raised to 10; recommendations no longer gate isLoading (they merge into the append-only queue in background). (6) Axis lock: after 14px the gesture commits to one axis, other axis pinned to 0; onEnd uses the locked axis. (7) SwipeCard gained allowUp + overlayLabels props; triage passes allowUp with Priority/Keep/Watched/Removed labels; up commit animates out upward.

bugs.error_message: Startup glitches: (1) Login screen flashes 1-2s before redirecting to Home for already-signed-in users. (2) Deck posters render one movie then swap to another movie 1-2s after first paint. (3) Opening a title detail briefly shows the previously viewed movie.
bugs.root_cause: (1) useSession's local-path effect subscribed via subscribeToSession, which synchronously replayed the module-level placeholder EMPTY_SESSION into the query cache before AsyncStorage hydration — isLoading flipped to false with a null session, the root gate redirected to /(auth)/welcome, then useAuthRedirect bounced to Home once the real session loaded. (2a) The persisted query cache dehydrated 'deck_exclusions' whose data holds Sets; JSON serializes Sets to {}, so a restored entry had zero exclusions AND skipped the loading gate — the deck composed with already-swiped titles, then swapped them out when fresh exclusions arrived. (2b) deck.tsx's display queue dropped any queued id missing from the latest recomposition (kept = prev.filter(availableIds.has)) and cardById only mapped the latest compose — late-arriving taste/exclusions/recommendations re-sorted the top-50 slice and could evict the visible top card. (3) useTitle used blanket placeholderData: keepPreviousData; in TanStack v5 placeholder data reports status success, so the detail screen rendered the previous title id's data instead of its loading state.
bugs.fix: (1) Added module-level isSessionHydrated; subscribeToSession only replays the current session to new subscribers after getLocalSession/getSupabaseSession/setLocalSession has resolved once — during 'checking' the session query stays pending, splash stays up. (2a) _layout.tsx dehydration now blocks NEVER_PERSIST_QUERY_ROOTS = auth, deck_exclusions, taste_signal, swipes (all local-source or Set/time-derived). (2b) Deck display queue is append-only per filterKey: ids never leave the queue, evicted cards stay renderable via an accumulated byId map, and the queue only rebuilds when filterKey changes or the deck is genuinely empty; useDeck now exposes filterKey. (3) useTitle placeholderData now only reuses previous data when the previous query's id (queryKey[3]) matches the current id, i.e. language changes of the same title.

bugs.error_message: Audit found three real settings/profile defects: (1) edit-profile.tsx has separate handle and display name inputs but useUpdateProfile only persists `name`, so the handle is silently dropped. (2) isHandleAvailable / isHandleTaken compares the candidate handle against `name` only, with no separate `handle` field, so two distinct handles were always treated as the same when their names matched. (3) settings-language.tsx writes profile.language but never calls i18n.changeLanguage, so the UI never re-renders in the saved language until the device locale matches. (4) welcome.tsx `handleAnon` skipped the root gate (`router.replace('/(app)')`) when isSupabaseConfigured is false, bypassing onboarding for anon users entirely.
bugs.root_cause: LocalProfile had only `name` (display name) and the schema was shaped so handle was an alias of name. Language writes never reached i18next. The anon path had a legacy Supabase-config branch that took a shortcut around the routing gate.
bugs.fix: Added a separate `handle` field on LocalProfile; isHandleTaken now checks handle first and falls back to name; useProfile/useUpdateProfile read and write both fields. settings-language.tsx and onboarding/region.tsx now call i18n.changeLanguage on success. New useI18nLanguage hook in the root layout syncs i18n whenever the saved profile language changes (covers app restart). welcome.tsx anon path always runs useAnonymousSignIn first then routes to '/' so the root gate decides where to send the user. New unit tests cover handle persistence, case-insensitive handle uniqueness, and clearUser handle cleanup.

bugs.error_message: User reported all settings/profile features broken: language change, region, services, genres, recommendation, auth, signout, and crucially 'when I do something and go back it redirects me to home even when I am in profile'. Five real defects: (1) navigation: (app)/_layout.tsx was a flat Tabs with every settings/edit-profile/title detail as a Tabs.Screen, so router.push to those screens from the profile tab pushed a stack screen whose back popped the tabs root and redirected to /(app)/deck. (2) Auth: createMockUser minted id=user-${Date.now()}, so every sign-in created a new user_id and the previous user data (wiped by useSignOut calling localDb.clearUser) was lost on re-login. (3) i18n: only en/tr/bg resource files existed, so picking Deutsch/Español/Français/Português fell back to en. (4) Sign-out from settings.tsx main page had no router.replace, leaving the user on a dead page. (5) Change password pushed to /(auth)/reset-password which uses useAuthRedirect and bounced signed-in users back to root.
bugs.file: app/(app)/_layout.tsx; app/(app)/(tabs)/_layout.tsx; src/components/SettingsPage.tsx; src/features/auth/hooks.ts; src/lib/localDb.ts; src/i18n/index.ts; src/i18n/locales/{de,es,fr,pt-BR}.json; app/(app)/settings.tsx; app/(app)/settings-privacy.tsx; app/(app)/change-password.tsx; app/(app)/settings-account.tsx; src/features/onboarding/hooks.ts; src/features/auth/useI18nLanguage.ts; app.config.ts; app/index.tsx
bugs.root_cause: Tabs+push was the wrong navigator stack shape; auth user_ids were unstable; i18n resource registry was missing languages; sign-out had no navigation handler; change-password lived in the auth group and ran the auth redirect.
bugs.fix: Restructured (app) to a Stack wrapping a (tabs) Tabs group: tab files (deck, watchlist, search, profile, index) live in (app)/(tabs)/ with their own _layout.tsx; modal screens (settings-*, edit-profile, privacy, terms, title/[id], change-password) stay as Stack Screens of (app)/_layout.tsx so the system back button pops to the originating tab. Added an in-screen back button to SettingsPage. Stable user_id = user-${email} for accounts, fixed 'anon' for anon sessions; signOut no longer clears user data so re-sign-in restores prefs/watchlist/profile. Added de/es/fr/pt-BR locale files with translated common strings; i18n detects language from expo-localization and supports the new langs. Real Google OAuth uses WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync with EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID + flixy://oauth/google redirect; falls back to the device mock when no client_id is configured. Both settings.tsx and settings-account.tsx sign-out now router.replace('/(auth)/welcome'). Change password moved to (app)/change-password.tsx. Optimistic updates added to useUpdatePreferences and useUpdateProfileRegion (onMutate + rollback on error). Personalization banner added to deck empty state. Added a Delete account action in settings-privacy that uses useDeleteLocalAccount.

OAuth now classifies browser results, logs redirect/result/handled flow without token URLs, waits briefly for Android deep-link session arrival, conditionally invalidates only completed sessions, dedupes repeated PKCE callbacks, and has callback/result regression tests. Deck/catalogue crash scope fixed earlier by bumping the AsyncStorage persister to flixy.query-cache.v2, adding shape-v2 title query keys, normalizing legacy Title[] and malformed cached titles to { titles, diagnostics }, guarding deck/cold-start consumers, hardening composeDeck against undefined/malformed candidates, and adding regression tests.

bugs.fix: syncSwipeEvent now writes localDb FIRST (idempotent by event_id); syncs session_id from a new SwipeEvent.discoverySessionId field (null outside discovery sessions); classifies permanent Postgres errors (23502/23503/23514/22P02/42501/42703) and resolves instead of throwing so the queue drops the event and self-heals; genres + discoverySessionId added to SwipeEventSchema so they survive queue hydration; detail screen now passes genres.
